disclaimer: Baseball-only research forecast. Past outcome never enters a pregame prediction. Unverified advanced inputs are marked missing.

full_distribution_validation.comparability_note: Version cohorts are disclosed; pooled metrics mix versions and are not an A/B test.
full_distribution_validation.warning: Small samples and past model selection do not establish calibration or a betting advantage.

winner.paired_date_bootstrap_note: Positive delta favors Elo. Only shown after at least 30 games on 10 dates; retrospective development history limits causal claims.

4.5.warning: No guaranteed combo win rate or market edge. Only new actual frozen pregame joint probabilities qualify.

5.5.warning: No guaranteed combo win rate or market edge. Only new actual frozen pregame joint probabilities qualify.

winner_ensemble_shadow_v23.note: Scores compare identical frozen, settled games. A positive Brier delta means the blend was worse. No challenger promotion based on this cohort.
winner_ensemble_shadow_v23.warning: Never refit on the 2026 postseason; 30 games or a high pick percentage alone cannot establish a reliable betting edge.

warnings: Fewer than 30 settled games is a small sample; no strong accuracy claims.

notes: This metric is not prediction accuracy. It measures the capture rate among imported official final games.
Missing game predictions are counted only after the official final enters local data.
Historical games before monitoring launch are excluded from this prospective capture rate.
GitHub scheduled jobs are best effort; missed windows must not be backdated.
Shadow records never count as additional original forecasts.
prospective_capture.scope: Only official completed MLB games already imported by the cloud service

two_stage_comparison.notes: Paired same-version comparisons only; transitions between model versions are excluded to avoid confusing new coefficients with fresher pregame data.
